ae045d5be1a3b9c61ff2eab29ab8f4f5.overview: A couple falls in love and agrees to meet in six months at the Empire State Building - but will it happen?
ae045d5be1a3b9c61ff2eab29ab8f4f5.tagline: In Italy... on the Mediterranean... across an ocean... and all over New York!

ae07d31155b2fec0285c4df032263af2.overview: A man tries to uncover an unconventional psychologist's therapy techniques on his institutionalised wife, amidst a series of brutal murders.
ae07d31155b2fec0285c4df032263af2.tagline: The Ultimate Experience in Inner Terror.

ae13128df41926837075c26f6145a47e.overview: The true story of the inseparable Von Erich brothers, who made history in the intensely competitive world of professional wrestling in the early 1980s. Through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, the brothers seek larger-than-life immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

ae2505f072f3a06103df605701ba65fa.overview: Marnie is a beautiful but emotionally withdrawn thief, stealing from employers before disappearing under new identities. When her new boss, Mark Rutland, discovers her secret, his fascination turns to obsession, and he blackmails her into marriage, convinced he can cure her. But as he probes deeper into Marnie’s fractured mind, long-buried fears and compulsions begin to surface.
ae2505f072f3a06103df605701ba65fa.tagline: The more he loved her . . . The more she hated him . . . For trying to unravel her secret!

ae4d7098530b76bd1cd4da675db7cd29.overview: A look at the lives of two teenage girls - inseparable friends Ginger and Rosa -- growing up in 1960s London as the Cuban Missile Crisis looms, and the pivotal event the comes to redefine their relationship.
ae4d7098530b76bd1cd4da675db7cd29.tagline: Friendship pulled them together. Love tore them apart.

ae64c0d181a7559ad8fe37aa8cace3db.overview: President McKinley asks Lt. Richard L. Perry to go underground to identify some obviously very well briefed Mid-Western bank robbers based in Saint Paul, Minnesota.
ae64c0d181a7559ad8fe37aa8cace3db.tagline: The story that shook a nation even to the highest places!

ae66491b1761e8a518f14572e0b2b7d8.overview: When Krisha returns to her estranged family for Thanksgiving dinner, past demons threaten to ruin the festivities.

ae681fb24d90521e4cea8b80dcd7d4f4.overview: Unfounded suspicions lead a married couple to begin divorce proceedings, whereupon they start undermining each other's attempts to find new romance.
ae681fb24d90521e4cea8b80dcd7d4f4.tagline: Danger! Wild woman on the loose!

aea649ce05d04a10cef3454f1b3c8926.overview: Fisher, an ex-detective, decides to take one final case when a mysterious serial killer claims the lives of several young girls. Fisher, unable to find the culprit, turns to Osbourne, a writer who was once respected for his contributions to the field of criminology. Fisher begins to use Osbourne's technique, which involves empathizing with serial killers; however, as the detective becomes increasingly engrossed in this method, things take a disturbing turn.

aea8c1ed1ecdf9046d8e528e6ef82ee5.overview: Rock-and-roll singer Mary Rose Foster's romantic relationships and mental health are continuously imperilled by the demands of life on the road.
aea8c1ed1ecdf9046d8e528e6ef82ee5.tagline: She gave and gave, until she had nothing left to give

aead5e927455bdb68698e0d5ca68857f.overview: In his dedicated pursuit of technology that will aid pilots to safely "fly blind" during adverse conditions, aerial innovator Ken Gordon is literally blinded in an accident, but this setback doesn't deter him from his goal.
aead5e927455bdb68698e0d5ca68857f.tagline: Tense and tender ... the down-to-earth drama of a pair of flying fools who rose to new heights of ecstasy on the wings of love.

aed796b853933fa58168ffe17ab2837c.overview: A veteran actress comes face-to-face with an uncomfortable reflection of herself when she agrees to take part in a revival of the play that launched her career 20 years earlier.

aee4ab2058cc0b5ba7aa031d26701b29.overview: When the murdered body discovered by beautiful, vivacious socialite Melsa Manton disappears, police and press label her a prankster until she and her group of friends prove them wrong.
aee4ab2058cc0b5ba7aa031d26701b29.tagline: Out of the social register and into the police blotter!
